blockers: candidate/collector/run.py:75 introduces a Python 3.10 compatibility regression: datetime.fromisoformat(started_at) rejects valid UTC ISO timestamps ending in Z on Python 3.10. A same-day initial collection or retry with now=lambda: '2026-08-29T12:00:00Z' therefore raises ValueError instead of collecting. The contract preserves UTC ISO clock inputs and Python >=3.10 support. Frozen tests exercise Z timestamps, but execution on Python 3.14 misses this failure.
